decisions: Difficulty tiers: Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced; title layout kept as 'EXTRA-<Tier> STAGE n' following the source; must match briefing_02's choice.
Briefing rec1/rec2/rec3 appear to be summary / victory condition / defeat condition; objectives written as terse imperatives.

sel#284/#285 rows look like internal/debug labels (portrait positions, all-maps stage select). Codes (AMR_FG, C), P)) kept verbatim; only the Japanese stage titles translated. Stage titles must be harmonised with the briefing_01/02 renderings of the same titles.
uncertain: S00348: LV3 shooting restriction read as level-3 shots only; chose 'LV3 shooting only'.
S00354: comma between two conditions (set time / annihilation), and/or unclear; chose 'Engage for a set time / destroy all enemies'.
S00349: pun title; chose 'Fistfight on Earth'.
S00362/S00363: chose 'Devil of the Earth' / 'Grim Reaper of Space'.
S00381/383 'Burning Sands Front', S00388/390 'Clash Zone', S00389/391/392 'Rushing Storm': no official English known; harmonise with briefing_01/02.

S00399/407 'Space Vortex', S00400/402/406/408 'Racing Through Space' (official Zeta ep. 50 English title may be 'Beyond the Stars'), S00396 'Through the White Darkness', S00398 'Four Forever': episode titles from memory, unverified.
